'''Mennac Vanderijar''', commonly referred to as '''Mennac the Hutt''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] (with a [[Gender/Legends|female personality]]) and a middle-level gangster in the criminal organization of the [[Vanderijar]] clan. Her palace/fortress was located on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Mennac's consort was [[Jobwah]] the Hutt, and she owned a [[kentril]], which was a vicious carnivorous rodent.
